calibration.delta_sign: Negative downward to match the current user-supplied screenshot
calibration.approx_image_readout_uncertainty: About +/-0.7 s and +/-0.5–1 percentage point; NOT instrument measurement uncertainty

method: HSV color masks; largest connected colored plot components exclude label text. Near-zero apex clusters and intervening visible trough tips define image-estimated piecewise straight traces. Overlapping color-boundary apexes use shared zero-line estimates, not independently resolved measurements. Baseline uses pixel-column center estimates because its small oscillations are poorly resolved. No equal-amplitude or equal-period waveform imposed. No random scatter added.
dense_grid: 0.2 s grid within each segment only; no extrapolation or connection across missing transition intervals
